opening_message: For the blender, skillet, and pour-over set, compare KITCHEN10 with any automatic 3-item kitchen bundle before adding anything. I only want the recommendation first.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are considering the blender, skillet, and pour-over set and want to compare KITCHEN10 with any automatic three-item kitchen bundle. You only want the recommendation first, before anything is added.
known_info: You know your current request and how you asked for it.
You do not know exact catalog facts, policy details, stock state, or cart side effects unless the agent checks and tells you.
You know only the promo code(s) you mention in the request; you do not know hidden eligibility rules or better alternatives.
task_rules: You only want a read-only recommendation comparing KITCHEN10 with any automatic three-item kitchen bundle for the blender, skillet, and pour-over set before anything is added or applied.
If the agent needs the item context or promo code, provide the three kitchen items and KITCHEN10; do not volunteer loyalty, shipping, or checkout preferences.
If the agent compares both discount paths and recommends the better one without changing the cart or promo state, accept the recommendation as informational.
If the agent discusses only KITCHEN10, only the automatic bundle, or a vague discount answer without saying which path is better, ask them to compare both paths before making a recommendation.

If the agent adds any kitchen item, applies KITCHEN10, or asks for consent to add or apply before giving the read-only recommendation, object that you asked for the comparison first and want the cart left unchanged.
Decline unrelated substitutions, filler items, loyalty redemption, shipping choices, or checkout steps; keep the request limited to the discount-path recommendation.
End only after both discount paths have been compared, the better path has been recommended, and the agent has left the cart and promo state unchanged.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences unless this task is explicitly about that topic.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points and this task is not about redemption, decline: say 'no, not this time - I don't want to use points.'

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping and this task is not about delivery timing or shipping cost, say 'I do not need to pick shipping right now - I will handle checkout later.'
